newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPS MUST PIERCE 136.00 TO REGAIN POISE.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPS MUST PIERCE 136.00 TO REGAIN POISE.

text.p: Italian BTP futures traded on LIFFE have a neutral outlook on Thursday after a poor performance in the previous session, but need to close above 136.00 to renew confidence, technical analysts said.
Although BTPs lost ground during the previous day's trading, analysts said it was significant that the 135.00 level was not violated. The low on Wednesday was 135.07.

"They're looking no worse than neutral," said a technical analyst at a European bank in London. "A close below 135.00 would be the first negative signal, and yesterday BTPs held that on a closing basis."
September BTP futures were trading up 0.26 at 135.49 by 0800 GMT.

A trader at a European bank in London said BTPs were locked in a broad sideways range between 136.42, the August 4 high and 134.73, the August 6 low. The contract has not traded outside that range since August 1.
"A break either way will give a one-and-a-half point move," he said. "It's a very uncertain market."
He said dollar/mark was breaking out of a head-and-shoulders pattern, which suggested the mark was now set to strengthen.
"That will be supportive of European bonds," he said.
Above the 136.00 range level, the European analyst cited resistance at 136.20 from congestion during the August 12 session.
Below the range there is support from the neckline of a head-and-shoulders pattern at 134.50, analysts said.
September Eurolira futures were up one basis point at 93.21 by 0845 GMT.
